typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ENDDATE as timestamp (),
	FileLocation as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	STARTDATE as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		INPUT_FILE_NM as string,
		INPUT_FILE_PATH as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT INPUT_FILE_NM,INPUT_FILE_PATH FROM  EDINETCLAIM_JC.cift.ETLEdinetInputFileLog ORDER BY INPUT_FILE_NM',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> EdinetJC	source(output(
		AGPCLMNBR as string,
		TPCLMNUMBER as string,
		SenderName as string,
		SenderID as string,
		ReceiverID as string,
		ReceiverName as string,
		VendorName as string,
		CreateDate as timestamp,
		FileName as string,
		CLMSUBTYPE as string,
		MEDICAID_MEDICARE as string,
		PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT * FROM DX_EDI.DBO.IHCS_CLAIMS ORDER BY FileName',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ODW
EdinetJC sort(asc(INPUT_FILE_NM, false)) ~> Sort1
ODW sort(asc(FileName, false)) ~> Sort
Sort,Sort1 join(FileName == INPUT_FILE_NM,
	joinType:'inner',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(FileName = FileName,
		INPUT_FILE_NM = INPUT_FILE_NM,
		AGPCLMNBR = AGPCLMNBR,
		TPCLMNUMBER = TPCLMNUMBER,
		SenderName = SenderName,
		SenderID = SenderID,
		ReceiverID = ReceiverID,
		ReceiverName = ReceiverName,
		VendorName = VendorName,
		CreateDate = CreateDate,
		INPUT_FILE_PATH = INPUT_FILE_PATH,
		CLMSUBTYPE = CLMSUBTYPE,
		MEDICAID_MEDICARE = MEDICAID_MEDICARE,
		PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER = PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER) ~> MergeJoinREFORMAT1
MergeJoinREFORMAT1 sink(input(
		CREATEDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLMSUBTYPE as string,
		AGPCLMNBR as string,
		RECEIVERID as string,
		SENDERNAME as string,
		VENDORNAME as string,
		INPUT_FILE_PATH as string,
		RECEIVERNAME as string,
		SENDERID as string,
		PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER as string,
		FILENAME as string,
		TPCLMNUMBER as string,
		MEDICAID_MEDICARE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CREATEDATE = CreateDate,
		CLMSUBTYPE,
		AGPCLMNBR,
		RECEIVERID = ReceiverID,
		SENDERNAME = SenderName,
		VENDORNAME = VendorName,
		INPUT_FILE_PATH,
		RECEIVERNAME = ReceiverName,
		SENDERID = SenderID,
		PATIENTACCOUNTNUMBER,
		FILENAME = FileName,
		TPCLMNUMBER,
		MEDICAID_MEDICARE)) ~> OLEDBDestination
